[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. The crowd keeps bouncing below with hands in the air. The camera pushes forward over their heads toward the speaker wall at a steady speed in one continuous move, the strobe beams flashing past, the stacked speakers growing larger and larger until one giant speaker cone fills the center of the frame, its rim pumping hard with every bass hit and dust jumping off it. The camera is still pushing in as the shot ends on <Picture 2>. No cut or transition occurs.
